Description: Target leakage or lookahead bias in customer review or repeat purchase features
Mitigation_Strategy: Enforce strict temporal cutoff (2018-03-01) and fit-transform only on training split
Contingency_Plan: Automated leakage tests in test_feature_leakage.py and test_temporal_leakage.py

Description: Conflation between counterfactual scenario simulation metrics and empirical holdout test metrics
Mitigation_Strategy: Strict segregation in MODEL_RESULTS_REGISTRY.csv and explicit UI metric badges
Contingency_Plan: Documentation disclaimer and automated consistency assertions in quality gates

Description: Probability miscalibration causing overconfident risk warnings in negative review classification
Mitigation_Strategy: Deploy Platt sigmoid scaling and Isotonic regression; verify Brier score and ECE
Contingency_Plan: Fallback to raw probabilities with explicit calibration warning banner

Description: Corrupted or missing fields in raw Olist CSV datasets
Mitigation_Strategy: Implement explicit data validation contracts and automated checksum validation
Contingency_Plan: Use interim clean parquets with deterministic imputation

Description: Hardware or dependency drift altering model training weights and metrics across machines
Mitigation_Strategy: Strictly pin dependencies in requirements.lock and fix all random seeds (seed=42)
Contingency_Plan: Provide pre-computed verified artifacts with bitwise SHA-256 verification

Description: SKKNI/LSP TRI assessor rejects evidence due to unit code discrepancies or unverified status
Mitigation_Strategy: Harmonize 100% of KUKs to statutory SKKNI 299/2020 (J.62DMI00.xxx.1); transparently disclose 3 external sign-offs
Contingency_Plan: Provide explicit candidate demonstration portfolio and mock client templates

Description: Arbitrary code execution or path traversal via untrusted user uploads or model deserialization
Mitigation_Strategy: Restrict model deserialization to repository-verified joblib/pt files; sanitize file paths
Contingency_Plan: Enforce strict file type and size bounds on user inputs

Description: OOM (Out-of-Memory) crash during deep learning or simulation on standard 8GB RAM laptops
Mitigation_Strategy: Optimize batch sizes (batch_size=64); leverage CPU-friendly BiLSTM architecture and chunked pandas processing
Contingency_Plan: Provide fallback tabular models and lightweight evaluation modes

Description: End-users or assessors misinterpret model predictions as prescriptive guarantees rather than probabilistic estimates
Mitigation_Strategy: Display explicit confidence intervals, calibrated probabilities, and operational boundary warnings on all UI pages
Contingency_Plan: Include dedicated Methodology and Limitations documentation directly linked from UI

Description: Hash mismatch or missing artifacts in final release ZIP package
Mitigation_Strategy: Automated package generation script that extracts to a clean verification sandbox and runs full test suite before sign-off
Contingency_Plan: Dual-destination packaging with verified SHA-256 ledger
